parts:
I am trying to create separation between the bars but the "width"
option doesn't seem to be working. Can you help me create space
between the bars?

p <- ggplot(data=txdata, aes(x=txdata$yeartx, y=..count.., fill=txdata$PROD))
p <- p + geom_bar(binwidth=1, width=.05) + theme_bw()
p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#63A70A", "#0079C1", "black"))
p <- p + theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=
element_blank(), panel.border=element_blank())
p <- p + ggtitle("Transplants by Year and Product Type\nAll Recipients")
p <- p + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45), plot.title=
element_text(size=15, face="bold"), axis.title=element_text
(face="bold"))
p <- p + theme(legend.justification=c(0,1), legend.position=c(0,1),
axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
p <- p + guides(fill=guide_legend(title=NULL))
p <- p + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1988,2013,1))
p <- p + scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 6000,1000))
p <- p + xlab("Year of Transplant") + ylab("Number of Transplants")
p
